newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Health to sell two hospitals.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Health to sell two hospitals.

text.p: Magellan Health Services Inc said Wednesday it signed definitive agreements with Priory Hospitals Holdings Ltd and Priory Hospitals Europe Ltd for the sale of its two psychiatric hospitals in London and its psychiatric hospital in Nyon, Switzerland.

After expenses associated with the sale are paid, the company said this transaction will provide Magellan with about $72 million for redeployment in the higher growth segments of the health care marketplace, including managed care and public sector privatization.
The company said it expects to record a gain of about $45 million for financial reporting purposes. The transaction should close in May 1997 pending regulatory approval, the company said.

In a separate agreement, Magellan said it will allow Priory to continue to use the "Charter" name at the facilities for seven years and the "Charter System," composed of certain intellectual and proprietary rights, for a six month period pending negotiation of a potential franchise relationship. The total purchase price for the facilities and the license agreement is $76 million.

Priory Hospitals Group, Britain's largest private provider of acute psychiatric care, operates sixteen hospitals and employs 1200 people. Priory Hospitals Group is owned by Mercury Asset Management Group Plc, the U.K.'s largest independent fund manager with 85 billion stg under management, the company said.
The divestiture of the European facilities is a continuation of the strategic plan previously announced by Magellan.
